best_idea: Route a touch by hit order (HUD first, menus second, world last), latch where the touch started so a held touch never becomes a move, and rate-limit hold re-sends to a 0.25 s floor.
decision_why: The hit order, the press-origin latch and the hold floor are the input rules our phone tap-to-move needs; the donor's globe defect (a held press on the top 25 px of a globe sends moves) is fixed by the latch, and the isometric inverse is rejected because our camera is 3D third-person.
acceptance: A 1 s hold on the top of the HP globe at 375 wide leaves the hero's position unchanged and sends no move; a 1 s hold on open ground sends at most 4 target updates; a tap during a cast is dropped (or buffered, whichever is chosen) and a server test asserts the move is validated against zone bounds.
